## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Compatibility

- [ ] No public API/ABI change
- [ ] No canonical `.apta` wire-format change
- [ ] No production DSP semantic change
- [ ] Any intentional compatibility change is documented and versioned

## Validation

List the exact builds, tests, fixtures or hardware checks performed.

## Documentation and release impact

- [ ] Public behaviour is documented
- [ ] Examples are updated when usage changed
- [ ] Changelog/release material is updated when required
- [ ] Security implications were considered

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated edits
- [ ] New public files include an SPDX license identifier where applicable
- [ ] Tests reproduce fixes and cover new behaviour
- [ ] Generated or frozen evidence was updated only through its documented process
